notes: metacareers.com/jobs/ 301s to /jobsearch/, a React/Relay app. The unfiltered listing is a single form-encoded POST to https://www.metacareers.com/graphql with doc_id=27129360303422352, fb_api_req_friendly_name=CareersJobSearchResultsV2DataQuery and a JSON variables value whose search_input object carries q, divisions, offices, roles, teams, sub_teams, leadership_levels, is_remote_only, sort_by_new and results_per_page; one response returns all All Jobs rows (1342) plus the featured job. The UI exposes a keyword box, Technologies (divisions), Teams, Employment type (roles) and Location (offices) plus a Relevance/Newest sort. Note the nesting: q and the facet arrays live inside variables.search_input, not at the top level of the request. Plain HTTP is refused (HTTP 400 Facebook error page), so the parameters are documented from the request body captured in Chromium, which the adapter replays.
